articles.title: Where to watch the Chargers vs 49ers game and what is the kickoff time today at SoFi Stadium?
articles.standfirst: San Francisco and Los Angeles meet in a preseason matchup with plenty of roster battles to watch
articles.summary: San Francisco and Los Angeles meet in a preseason matchup with plenty of roster battles to watch
articles.body:
The San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Chargers meet at SoFi Stadium on Thursday, August 20, with both teams using their second preseason game to evaluate players ahead of the regular season.

The game is scheduled to begin at 7 p.m. Pacific Time (10 p.m. ET) in Inglewood, California.

For viewers in the UK, that means a 3 a.m. BST kickoff on Friday, August 21. The matchup will be nationally televised on NFL Network, while local broadcast arrangements are also available in the teams' respective markets. The 49ers' official viewing guide confirms the broadcast and streaming information for the game.

For fans unable to attend at SoFi Stadium, NFL Network is therefore the primary national television option. Availability can vary according to television provider and market, so viewers should check their local listings before kickoff.

The Chargers enter the contest after opening their preseason with a convincing 27-7 victory over the Houston Texans .

The 49ers , meanwhile, began their exhibition schedule against the Tennessee Titans and now travel south to Los Angeles for the second of their three preseason games. San Francisco's published schedule lists Thursday's contest at SoFi Stadium for 7 p.m. PT.

What to watch when the 49ers face the Chargers

Although preseason results ultimately carry little weight, Thursday's game is important for players attempting to secure roster spots, starting positions and roles within their respective offenses and defenses.

One of the biggest storylines for San Francisco is the amount of playing time given to its starters. The 49ers are expected to use at least some of their first-team players, with quarterback Brock Purdy among the names generating interest.

However, San Francisco is also dealing with several injuries, meaning the coaching staff will have to balance evaluation with caution. The 49ers ' receiving corps could look different depending on which players are available.

The quarterback situation is naturally one of the biggest attractions for the Chargers as well. Los Angeles has Justin Herbert , but preseason games are primarily about assessing the wider roster rather than chasing victories.

Young players and those competing for depth-chart positions can receive opportunities that would be difficult to obtain during the regular season.

The matchup also follows joint practices between the two teams, giving coaches another opportunity to assess how their players respond against unfamiliar opposition.

Reports from San Francisco's side highlighted struggles in the secondary during those sessions, making Thursday's game a useful test for the revamped defense.

For the Chargers , the game represents their first preseason appearance at home in 2026. The team's official site describes the meeting with San Francisco as the opening game of its preseason home schedule at SoFi Stadium.

A late-night game for East Coast and UK viewers

The 10 p.m. ET start makes this one of the later games on Thursday's preseason schedule, while UK viewers face an overnight start.

The contest is nevertheless an intriguing opportunity to watch players competing for important roster roles before the final preseason week arrives.

The NFL's official preseason schedule places San Francisco's next exhibition game against the Las Vegas Raiders on August 27, while the Chargers will close their preseason against the Los Angeles Rams .

So, for anyone planning to watch tonight, the key information is straightforward: 49ers at Chargers , 7 p.m. PT/10 p.m. ET at SoFi Stadium, with NFL Network carrying the national broadcast.

articles.title: Olivia Culpo shows off her baby bump and shares a special message as McCaffrey returns to the 49ers
articles.standfirst: The couple is entering a new chapter as a family.
articles.summary: The couple is entering a new chapter as a family.
articles.body:
O livia Culpo once again gave fans a glimpse into a very special chapter of her life, this time letting her pregnancy take center stage . The model shared mirror photos showing off her baby bump and accompanied one of them with a reflection on the changes her body is going through.

Olivia Culpo shows off her baby bump in two very different looks

In the first photo, Culpo appeared in a long-sleeved white dress, paired with an updo that gave her a more elegant and understated look .

In the second image, she went for something completely different: a brown two-piece with a cutout around the abdomen and a plunging neckline, while wearing her hair down.

But Olivia did not stop at the photos. She also used the moment to share a reflection that showed how she is experiencing this stage on a much more personal level .

Culpo wrote: “Growing bigger by the day and more proud of my body than ever,” making it clear that she feels especially proud of the changes she is experiencing.

The model also expressed her admiration for her body’s ability to carry and develop her children with so little time between them, describing the moment as an experience she feels deeply grateful for.

While she continues to share some moments from this journey publicly , Christian is going through an important stage of his own career.

Christian McCaffrey is back at work with the 49ers

The running back has resumed activities with the San Francisco 49ers after spending several weeks away from practice because of muscle tightness.

His return came on August 23, when he worked with his teammates again following that period on the sidelines. McCaffrey said he is feeling good and is now continuing his preparation ahead of the start of the regular season .

For San Francisco, having the running back back on the field is important news as the team enters the final stretch of its preparations , with his availability once again becoming one of the key storylines to follow.

McCaffrey remains one of the 49ers' most important offensive players, and his return gives the team another key piece as it moves toward the regular season.

articles.title: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York arrested after prostitution raid in Ohio
articles.standfirst: The San Francisco CEO pleaded no contest to two misdemeanors
articles.summary: The San Francisco CEO pleaded no contest to two misdemeanors
articles.body:
A weekend arrest involving San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York moved quickly from a serious initial allegation to a pair of misdemeanor convictions, leaving the NFL with a separate decision to make about whether discipline will follow.

York , 46, was arrested Sunday in East Palestine, Ohio, and booked into the Columbiana County Jail on suspicion of engaging in prostitution and possessing criminal tools. He was released later that day after posting $5,000 bond.

By Monday, however, the case had changed significantly. Court records cited by TMZ show prosecutors amended the prostitution-related charge to misdemeanor disorderly conduct.

York then pleaded no contest to that count and to misdemeanor possession of criminal tools. That means York wasn't convicted of engaging in prostitution, despite that being the allegation attached to his original arrest.

The arrest reportedly took place at the Wheat Hill Mobile Home Community off State Route 170, with local police assisting the Mahoning Valley Human Trafficking Task Force.

Jed York ordered to pay fine

York was ordered to pay $1,150 in fines and received credit for time already served in jail. One-day jail terms on each misdemeanor count, to run concurrently, were also handed down.

Authorities also ordered York ’s cellphone returned to him, while $160 seized during the case was forfeited to the Mahoning Valley Human Trafficking Task Force, according to WKBN.

The 49ers hadn't immediately issued a public statement in the reports provided, while the NFL had also not confirmed whether a formal investigation had begun. ​ ​"We are aware of the matter which will be reviewed under the personal conduct policy," a league spokesperson told TMZ.

York has deep connections to Ohio. He was born and raised in Youngstown, not far from where the arrest occurred.

He became president and CEO of the 49ers in 2008, continuing a family connection with the franchise that dates back decades. His parents, John York and Denise DeBartolo York , serve as co-chairmen, while his grandfather, Edward DeBartolo Sr. , purchased the team in 1977.

NFL could still act despite amended charge

The court resolution doesn't necessarily close the matter from the league’s perspective. Owners and executives are subject to the NFL’s Personal Conduct Policy , meaning the league can review conduct independently of the outcome in criminal court.

That leaves open the possibility that York could face discipline even though the engaging-in-prostitution count was reduced before his plea. His position within the league also extends beyond San Francisco.

The 49ers list York as serving on several NFL committees involving stadiums, media operations, business ventures, fan engagement and major events.

What happens next may now depend less on Ohio prosecutors and more on how the NFL chooses to respond.

articles.title: Jed York prostitution scandal: 49ers owner filed for divorce months before arrest
articles.standfirst: Jed York’s shocking off-field controversy takes another turn.
articles.summary: Jed York’s shocking off-field controversy takes another turn.
articles.body:
The owner of the San Francisco 49ers , Jed York , filed for divorce from his wife Danielle Belluomini just months before being arrested for an alleged attempt to purchase sexual services for $140 , according to court documents .

York filed the petition on May 11 in Santa Clara County . The case also lists the couple’s two minor children as additional parties.

According to records obtained by the California Post , the divorce case has not yet been finalized.

In the filing, York cited “irreconcilable differences” as the reason for the separation. The document states that the couple was married on June 24, 2011 , while the official date of separation is listed as “to be determined.”

The divorce news comes after York was arrested Sunday morning in Ohio, after authorities alleged that the businessman had arranged a sexual encounter with a woman in exchange for $140.

According to police, the 49ers owner was arrested “at the meeting location,” an East Palestine trailer park, after he was allegedly found in possession of the cellphone used to arrange the encounter.

York initially faced charges of soliciting prostitution and possession of criminal tools . However, on Monday he reached a legal agreement and pleaded no contest to a reduced charge of disorderly conduct, while also pleading no contest to a charge related to possession of criminal tools.

The 49ers owner was sentenced to one day in jail, though he received credit for time served, and was also ordered to pay $1,150 in fines .

The San Francisco 49ers released a statement following their owner’s arrest:

“As this is a legal matter, which has been resolved, we will not be providing any further comment at this time.”

The NFL also confirmed it was aware of the situation and said the matter will be reviewed under the league’s personal conduct policy.

articles.title: Who is Danielle Belluomini? Wife of 49ers owner Jed York, who was arrested on prostitution charges
articles.standfirst: A private family life has become public after a 2026 divorce filing and York’s Ohio arrest
articles.summary: A private family life has become public after a 2026 divorce filing and York’s Ohio arrest
articles.body:
Long before Jed York became one of the NFL’s most recognizable team owners, Danielle Belluomini was building a career far from football’s glare.

The former science teacher married the San Francisco 49ers owner in 2011, and the couple went on to have two sons while largely keeping their family life out of public view.

That low-key approach has now been disrupted by a pending divorce and the renewed scrutiny surrounding York after his recent arrest in Ohio.

Court records cited in the supplied reports show York filed for divorce in Santa Clara County Superior Court on May 11, citing irreconcilable differences.

Belluomini later responded, and the case remained pending in the latest available records. The filing reportedly lists the couple’s two minor sons and notes the existence of a premarital agreement.

Danielle Belluomini built life outside football

Belluomini worked in education before and during the early years of her relationship with York.

She taught sixth-grade science at a public school in San Francisco’s Hunters Point neighborhood and later volunteered at a charter school in East Palo Alto.

The couple married in 2011. Their first son, Jaxon, was born in October 2012, with their second son, Brixton, arriving later.

Unlike York , whose role with the 49ers placed him regularly in front of cameras, Belluomini rarely became part of the public conversation. One of the couple’s more visible appearances together came at the 2017 NFL Honors in Houston.

Her social media presence has also remained limited. Her Instagram account is private, while her X account has been largely inactive in recent years.

That contrast helped preserve a sense of privacy around the marriage even as York ’s professional profile continued to grow.

Divorce filing came before Ohio arrest

The couple’s pending divorce attracted new attention after York was arrested in East Palestine, Ohio, on August 23 during an operation involving local police and the Mahoning Valley Human Trafficking Task Force.

He was initially accused of engaging in prostitution and possessing criminal tools. The legal outcome was different from the original allegation.

Prosecutors amended the prostitution-related charge to misdemeanor disorderly conduct, and York pleaded no contest to that charge as well as misdemeanor possession of criminal tools.

He was ordered to pay $1,150 in fines and received credit for time already served in jail.

The 49ers later issued a brief statement: “As this is a legal matter, which has been resolved, we will not be providing any further comment at this time.”

There is no evidence in the supplied material linking the Ohio case to the divorce filing, which occurred several months earlier.

What can be said with certainty is that Belluomini , after years of avoiding the spotlight, is now receiving far more public attention because of legal developments involving her estranged husband.

Her story remains largely defined by privacy, family and a career in education, even as circumstances around York have pulled their marriage into the headlines.

articles.title: A well-known Nevada brothel wants to teach Jed York and the rest of the 49ers how to pay for sex without breaking the law
articles.standfirst: Sheri’s Ranch makes an unusual offer after the 49ers owner’s Ohio arrest
articles.summary: Sheri’s Ranch makes an unusual offer after the 49ers owner’s Ohio arrest
articles.body:
San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York has already resolved the criminal case stemming from his arrest in Ohio, but the unusual circumstances surrounding the incident have now produced an unexpected offer from Nevada.

Sheri’s Ranch , a licensed brothel in Pahrump, has publicly offered York and other NFL figures a lesson in how Nevada’s regulated brothel system works.

The proposal comes only days after York was arrested during an undercover prostitution operation in East Palestine, Ohio.

Dena Duff , the brothel’s madam and general manager, told TMZ that the establishment would be willing to educate York, as well as other NFL owners and players, about the legal framework surrounding licensed prostitution in Nevada.

Duff said: "Nevada's licensed brothels offer something an NFL owner should appreciate: a legal, regulated environment where discretion and privacy are paramount. Sheri's would be happy to host Jed, along with any interested NFL owners and players, for a seminar on how Nevada's legal brothel system works, why discretion is such an important part of the business and, frankly, how to do prostitution correctly."

The tongue-in-cheek invitation follows a case that has attracted considerable attention because of York's position within one of the NFL's most prominent franchises.

York was arrested August 23 after authorities said he responded to an online advertisement that had actually been created as part of an undercover operation.

According to court documents, he eventually traveled to a location in East Palestine expecting to meet a sex worker. He was initially accused of engaging in prostitution.

The prostitution allegation did not remain the final charge. Prosecutors amended the case, and York pleaded no contest to misdemeanor disorderly conduct and possessing criminal tools. He received a sentence of time served and was ordered to pay $1,150.

Why the Nevada offer has an NFL connection

Sheri's Ranch has made a similar pitch before. Duff pointed to the brothel's 2019 offer to then- New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft , who had been caught up in a Florida prostitution investigation. The charges against Kraft were ultimately dropped.

The latest invitation also comes with an obvious contrast in surroundings. York's arrest took place at an Ohio mobile-home community as part of a police sting.

Sheri's Ranch , by comparison, markets itself as a fully licensed Nevada establishment with accommodations and amenities including a hotel, restaurant, bar, pool, spa and private bungalows.

Nevada's prostitution laws are also considerably different from those in Ohio. Licensed brothels are permitted in some Nevada counties, although prostitution remains illegal in many parts of the state, including Las Vegas and Reno.

That distinction is crucial: simply being in Nevada does not automatically make paying for sex lawful.

York's case has also raised questions beyond the courtroom. The NFL is reviewing the incident under its personal conduct policy, meaning the matter could still have consequences for the 49ers owner despite the Ohio case being resolved.

At the team level, however, coach Kyle Shanahan has attempted to keep the controversy separate from football. Shanahan said the matter was personal and indicated that it had not become a distraction inside the locker room.

Linebacker Fred Warner similarly said the team remained focused on preparing for the season.

For now, Sheri's Ranch 's offer is unlikely to become an actual NFL seminar. But Duff's comments have added another bizarre chapter to a story that has already taken York from a police sting in Ohio to national headlines, and now, unexpectedly, to an invitation from one of Nevada's most recognizable brothels.

articles.title: Jed York tells officer he was 'just driving' as bodycam captures 49ers owner's arrest
articles.standfirst: Newly released police footage shows the stunned 49ers owner moments before officers placed him in handcuffs
articles.summary: Newly released police footage shows the stunned 49ers owner moments before officers placed him in handcuffs
articles.body:
S an Francisco 49ers owner Jed York appeared stunned when police approached his vehicle in Ohio , and newly released bodycam footage now shows the uncomfortable moments before one of the NFL's most powerful executives was placed under arrest.

The video shows an officer approaching York and asking what he was doing in the area . "Just driving," York responds. Asked whether he was there to meet someone, he answers, "No." Moments later, officers order him out of the vehicle and place him in handcuffs.

What led police to Jed York

According to authorities, York had actually arrived as part of an undercover prostitution sting. Investigators allege he responded to an online advertisement while using the name "Joe" and communicated with undercover officers before traveling to the meeting location . Police said an agreement involving payment for sexual activity had been made before he arrived.

Authorities seized York's phone and cash during the arrest. He was initially charged with engaging in prostitution and possessing criminal tools before posting $5,000 bond. The prostitution charge was later amended to disorderly conduct, and York pleaded no contest to that charge and possessing criminal tools. He received one day in jail, credited for time already served, and $1,150 in fines.

The legal case may be resolved, but the NFL could still have the final word. The league has said it will review the incident under its Personal Conduct Policy, while the 49ers have declined further comment. For York, however, the newly released footage has brought an incident that happened away from the football field suddenly back into the spotlight beginning with two words captured on a police camera: "Just driving."

According to authorities, York had actually arrived as part of an undercover prostitution sting. Investigators allege he responded to an online advertisement while using the name "Joe" and communicated with undercover officers before traveling to the meeting location . Police said an agreement involving payment for sexual activity had been made before he arrived.

Authorities seized York's phone and cash during the arrest. He was initially charged with engaging in prostitution and possessing criminal tools before posting $5,000 bond. The prostitution charge was later amended to disorderly conduct, and York pleaded no contest to that charge and possessing criminal tools. He received one day in jail, credited for time already served, and $1,150 in fines.

The legal case may be resolved, but the NFL could still have the final word. The league has said it will review the incident under its Personal Conduct Policy, while the 49ers have declined further comment. For York, however, the newly released footage has brought an incident that happened away from the football field suddenly back into the spotlight beginning with two words captured on a police camera: "Just driving."
